description: MoveMate connects your training data to ChatGPT. Ask about your workout history, volume, and personal records; track progression on specific lifts; search MoveMate's exercise library (including your own custom exercises); and schedule a planned workout that shows up in your MoveMate app on the date you choose. Reading your stats is free — scheduling a workout requires a connected MoveMate account.

defaultPrompt: How's my training been going over the last 90 days?
Schedule a push day workout for me this Wednesday
Find me some quad exercises I can do with dumbbells
